sentences.text: This is second application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed by the applicant who has been arrested on 19.05.2021 in connection with Crime No.286 of 2021 registered at Police Station Timarni, District-Harda for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC and Section 5(L) of POCSO Act, 2012.

His first application is dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 16.06.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.No.26107 of 2022 by a coordinate Bench of this Court with liberty to repeat after material Prathvi Raj Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120345115/
1 witnesses are examined.
As per prosecution, on 15.04.2021, prosecutrix has gone to school but not return back home,
therefore, her father lodged a missing report.

entities.text: Prathvi Raj Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
He has not committed any offence.
As per statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, the prosecutrix has conceded that she has gone with applicant on her own will.
The applicant is in jail since 19.05.2021.Charge sheet
has been filed and conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds he prays for grant of bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed the prayer.
He submits that the age of prosecutrix was only 15 years at the time of incident, hence, her consent is immaterial, therefore, he prays for its dismissal.
Learned counsel for the objector has opposed the application and submits that no evidence of material witnesses have been recorded.
Looking to the entire facts and circumstances of the case, the gravity of the offence, in the opinion of this Court, the applicant does not deserve the benefit of bail.
Consequently, this second application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail filed on behalf of applicant stands dismissed.
